tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rtsa gsum rig 'dzin srog sgrub las/ byin 'beb me tog char sil ngo mtshar lha'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥsarba lo ka dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐/ ā yu sid+dhi pha la hring hring dzaḥdzaḥsarba pañca a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ hrīḥ zag med 'od lnga 'khrug pa rdo rje'i dbyings// skye med sgyu 'phrul chos dbyings klong rab 'byams// 'byams klas rgyal ba zhi khro'i sprin phung 'khrigs// deng 'dir sgrub mchog gdung bas 'bod lags so// 'od gsal rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gzhal yas nas// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nā gārdzu na dang// hūm̐ kār bī ma pra chen hasti la// gdung bas 'bod lags brtse bas dgongs te gshegs// rig 'dzin chen po dha na saṃskṛ dang*// de wa tsan+d+ra shān+tiṃ gar+bha dang*// kun 'dus rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gis// rig 'dzin yongs 'dus byin rlabs dngos grub stsol// 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung gi lha// yang dag thugs dang che mchog yon tan tshogs// phrin las phur pa ma mo rbod gtong gis// mthu stobs mchog thun dngos grub 'dir stsol cig /'jig rten mchod bstod dmod pa drag sngags dang// rig 'dzin bla ma sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi// lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga 'dir gshegs shig /mi zad mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsol// snang ba mtha' yas chos sku 'gyur med bcud// longs sku rigs lnga o rgyan yab yum dang*// chos rgyal rje 'bangs lo paṇa tshom bu rnams// zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse nas 'dir gshegs shig

/sprul pa'i gter ston gling brgyad dri med lnga// mchog sprul gsum dang mkhan slob brgyud pa bcas// zab mo gsang sngags bshad sgrub chu bo'i mgo /brgyud bcas bla ma thams cad 'dir gshegs shig /mtsho skyes rdo rje rgyal ba'i dgongs gsang nas// tsit+ta 'bar ba lhun grub 'dab brgya'i rtser// theg pa dgu rdzogs thabs shes nyi zla'i steng*// nyis brgya nyer lnga dgongs 'dus lha tshogs gshegs// pad+ma badz+ra bud+dha thod phreng rtsal// mi bskyod rdo rje pad+ma dbang chen dang*// rig 'dzin thod rtsal drag po me yi phreng*// ma 'gags thugs rje rol pa'i klong nas gshegs// sangs rgyas dpa' bo dpal chen rta mgrin dbang*// lag na rdo rje dpa' bo dpa' mor bcas// sgo mtshams skyong mdzad gtsang rigs dpal mgon sogs// bka' btsan dregs pa'i bka' srung 'dir gshegs shig /pul+li ra ma dzā lan dha ra dang*// au ḍīn arbu ta sogs gnas bzhi dang*// go da wa ri rā me shwa ra dang*// de wī ko ṭi mal+la wa nas gshegs// gnas dang nye gnas brgyad kyi dpa' bo dang*// ḍā ki dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs ma lus// byin rlabs thugs rje'i na bun thibs se thib// bshams pa'i dam rdzas ye shes sems dpar bzhugs// kā ma rū pa o tri ya sogs dang*// tri sha ku ne ko sa la gnas pa'i// ḍā ki shugs 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// zhing dang nye zhing skyong mdzad 'dir gshegs shig

/ka liṅka dang lam+ba ka la sogs// kañci ka dang hi ma lar gnas pa'i// tshan dho dang ni nye ba'i tshan dho'i bdag /'bod pa'i gdung dbyangs gsan nam 'dir gshegs shig /pre ta pu ri gṛ ha de wa dang*// sau rāṣ+ṭa s+r+ṇu dwī pa sogs// 'du ba dang ni nye ba'i 'du ba dang*// snang srid dwangs ma'i bcud bsdus 'dir gshegs shig /na ga ra dang sin+dhu ma ru ta// ku lu ta la gnas mdzad dam can tshogs// dur khrod dang ni nye ba'i dur khrod nas// dam rdzas ri ltar spungs pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// gtum drag nags tshal phun tshogs 'jigs su rung*// mun pa mi bzad 'ur 'ur 'bar ba dang*// kī li'i sgra can tshang 'khrigs ha ha rgod// dur khrod brgyad la gnas rnams 'dir gshegs shig /mkha' spyod ye shes rang bzhin sbubs yangs par// lhun grub gzhal yas 'ja' zer 'khyil ba'i bdag /phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams sras dang bcas// bdag yid gdung bas 'bod do 'dir gshegs shig /'od lnga ye shes sbubs na 'jigs rung gi /ma mo gshin rje phur pa'i gzhal yas khang*// sde brgyad lha srin 'khrugs pa'i bkod ra nas// bka' gter bstan pa skyong rnams 'dir gshegs shig /glu gar rol mo dril g.yer gling bu dang*// sil snyan pheg rdob lha mi'i rnga sgrar bcas// yan lag rgya mtsho snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra// mkha' spyod rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// chos dbyings gting mtha' bdud rtsi'i mtsho bskyil zhing*// snang srid thams cad rak+ta'i rba spungs 'khyom// rang rig zhun mar tshul khrims dri bzang dang*// snang srid phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// bar snang dag pa'i ngos yangs sku dang gsung*// thugs kyi thig le mi zad mkhyen brtse'i gter// spos sprin lha yi me tog char dang ldan// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin cig phob// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar 'dod yon lnga'i// srid zhi'i yon tan kun spungs yid bzhin mchog

/ra sā yā naṃ rdzas mchog 'di nyid la// tshe bcud nus spor dngos grub char chen phob// bar snang lha ru rjid pa'i thugs rje dang*// rig 'dzin sgrub mchog 'dus pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// skye bdun sman gyi gong bu 'od 'bar zhing*// 'ja' 'od dri bzang 'thul ba'i ngo mtshar stsol// 'dzam gling yangs pa'i 'khor lo sman dris gang*// rigs drug myong reg skye 'gro 'od skur yal// mthong thos dran reg 'khor bar phyir mi ldog /yid bzhin re ba skong ba'i dpal du shog /yul bde rdzogs ldan lha yul ngo mtshar gyur// 'gro kun gnas skabs bde skyid dpal gyis 'tsho// rtsi bcud lo 'bras 'dod dgu'i nam mkha'i rdzing*// 'jig rten bde legs thams cad 'dir stsol cig /nad gdon bgegs rigs 'gal rkyen mthar bskrad nas// thogs med drag sngags nus mthu'i dngos grub stsol// mu ge dmag 'khrug ming tsam med par shog /skye med a ti'i 'od gsal snying po'i sbubs// srid zhi'i spang thob zad pa'i 'pho ba che// 'ja' 'od rdo rje'i lding khang rtse mo ru// skal bzang 'dir tshogs rdo rje'i sku brnyes shog /'brel dang 'brel 'gyur pha ma mkha' mnyam 'gro /gsang chen sgrub pa'i tshom bur 'khod pa rnams// sku lnga'i zhing du las bzhi'i dngos grub thob/ khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par mdzod// rig 'dzin bla ma 'ja' skur 'od du thim// yi dam lha tshogs 'od skur bdud rtsir zhu// mkha' 'gro dam can ro bcud nus par 'bar// sgrub rdzas bkra shis 'ja' skur lams se lam// dam ye dbyer med chos dbyings phyam yangs ngang*// skye 'gag bral ba a ti chos zad gzhir// mi g.yo rab bzhag rig stong skye med a// rdo rje snying po 'od gsal thig ler hūm̐//

pad gzhon 'khor lo mkha' la rab bzhad pa'i// mdangs la rjes chags lha yi bye'u chung*// bde ba'i glu sgras skyo sangs byed po'i gnas// sman sdings zhes pa mkha' spyod 'bras ljongs rtser// nam mkha' 'jigs med sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor pas// mkha' spyod rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i bcud 'gugs pa'i// pho nya 'di ni rang rig rdo rje 'chang*// bla mar rtogs des gnyug ma'i thol glu blangs// dge bas 'gro kun dngos grub mchog thob shog /dge'o/// /
